Classic.description: Default. Includes shared learning: 15% of every JP gain also goes into the other jobs the party used in combat. Even a light playthrough masters 4+ jobs (see DESIGN.md, Pacing).

Fast.description: About 1.6x the JP of Classic. For short playthroughs or to try many jobs.

Grindy.description: About 0.55x the JP of Classic. Closer to FFT's slow job mastery; most players will not master everything.

PureFFT.description: Only FFT's own JP sources (per action, spillover, TIC +30%; no shared learning). Shows how slow FFT's numbers are in BG3's finite fights; not recommended for play.

help.JP.GlobalMultiplier: Scales every JP source. Quick knob: !fft_mult 1.5
help.JP.Action.Base: FFT formula constant: JP per action = Base + PerJobLevel x job level + floor(character level / CharLevelDivisor).
help.JP.Action.PerJobLevel: FFT formula: JP per job level of the job in use.
help.JP.Action.CharLevelDivisor: FFT formula: character level divisor (0 = ignore character level).
help.JP.Action.EnhancedBonus: TIC Enhanced bonus on own action JP (0.3 = +30%). Not applied to spillover.
help.JP.Action.Multiplier: BG3 pacing factor for action JP (and spillover).
help.JP.Action.BonusActionWeight: Fraction of action JP for casts that only cost a bonus action.
help.JP.Action.CountOutOfCombat: Also give action JP outside combat.
help.JP.Action.RequireActionCost: Only casts that cost an action or bonus action earn JP (reactions and free casts do not).
help.JP.Action.MaxPerTurn: Max casts per turn that earn JP (0 = no cap).
help.JP.Action.ExcludeSpells: Spell IDs that never earn JP (e.g. the jump spell).
help.JP.Action.ExcludePrefixes: Spell ID prefixes that never earn JP.
help.JP.Spillover.Share: Share of an ally's action JP that every other party member in the same fight gets in that job (FFT: 0.25).
help.JP.Spillover.RequireUnlocked: Spillover only into jobs the receiver has unlocked (TIC: false).
help.JP.Shared.Share: Shared learning (Fell Seal rule): this share of every JP gain also goes into each of the character's other jobs that the party used in combat (see Scope; 0.15 = 15%, 0 = off).
help.JP.Shared.Scope: FightJobs (Fell Seal): the jobs of everyone in the current fight, or outside a fight, in the party's latest fight. AllJobs: every other job. Locked jobs are included either way.
help.JP.Shared.RequireUnlocked: Shared JP only goes into jobs the character has unlocked (Fell Seal: false).
help.JP.Victory.Base: JP per participant when a fight ends.
help.JP.Victory.PerCharLevel: Extra victory JP per character level.
help.JP.XPShare: JP per point of BG3 XP gained (quests, exploration, checks and combat all give XP).
help.JP.Camp.Share: Party members who were not in a fight get this share of the participants' average JP.
help.JP.Boost.Action: JP Boost applies to action JP.
help.JP.Boost.Victory: JP Boost applies to victory JP.
help.JP.Boost.XP: JP Boost applies to XP-share JP.
help.JP.Boost.LongRest: JP Boost applies to long-rest JP.
help.JobLevels.Thresholds: Total JP earned in a job for job levels 2..8 (TIC/WotL: 200, 400, 700, 1100, 1600, 2200, 3000).
help.Rules.StartingJob.Default: Starting primary job for classes not listed in ByClass.
help.Rules.StartingJob.ByClass: Starting primary job per BG3 class name.
help.Rules.ChangeJobOutOfCombatOnly: Primary job can only change out of combat.
help.Rules.LearnOutOfCombatOnly: Abilities can only be learned out of combat.
help.Rules.SlotsOutOfCombatOnly: Secondary/reaction/support/movement can only change out of combat.
help.Notifications.LevelUp: Show a notification on job level up.
help.Notifications.Unlock: Show a notification when a job unlocks.
help.Notifications.Mastered: Show a notification when a job is mastered.
help.Notifications.JPGain: Print every JP gain to the console (noisy).
help.XPPollMs: How often (game-time ms) XP is checked for the XP share.
help.Telemetry.Enabled: Write per-fight and per-rest numbers to the telemetry file.
help.Telemetry.File: Telemetry file, relative to the Script Extender folder.
help.Telemetry.MaxLines: Oldest telemetry lines are dropped beyond this.
